events.name: Dillon Fence
events.info: Dillon Fence Greg Humphreys, Chis Goode, Scott Carle, and Kent Alphin returns in 2026 to celebrate their second album, Outside In! The band, formed as college students at UNC Chapel Hill and Wake Forest in the late 80s, made a splash with their first album Rosemary, with songs honed at countless beer-soaked frat parties and nightclub shows. Their follow-up sophomore album, Outside In produced by Lou Giordano at Fort Apache Studios in Boston, MA was quite different than Rosemary. Many Dillon Fence fans consider Outside In to be the bands best collection of songs. Outside In took the band out on tours with bands like X, Lush, and Weezer, and onto MTVs 120 Minutes with music videos for Collapsis and Black Eyed Susan. Dillon Fence will feature songs from Outside In at this years run of holiday dates along with many crowd favorites.
events.pleaseNote: Greenfields Productions presents Dillon Fence: Celebrating Outside In Tour Join us on Friday, December 18, for an unforgettable evening with Dillon Fence as they bring their Celebrating Outside In Tour to the Brooklyn Arts Center. This is a general admission standing room show on the main floor, with reserved seated tickets available in the balcony, which also features access to a private bar. Doors open at 7:00 p.m. This is an all ages event, so everyone is welcome to enjoy the show. We look forward to seeing you for a great night of live music!
